name: Yoruba
source: Our Father, Hail Mary (Yinyin Maria) and Glory Be follow the traditional Yoruba Catholic wording used in Nigeria (older orthography, tone marks omitted); Creed, Fatima prayer and mystery titles rendered by Claude — needs checking by a native Catholic speaker. Hail Holy Queen and closing prayer left null (fall back to English/Latin).

prayers.signOfCross: Ni orukọ Baba, ati ti Ọmọ, ati ti Ẹmi Mimọ. Amin.
prayers.apostlesCreed: Mo gba Ọlọrun Baba Olodumare gbọ, Ẹlẹda ọrun on aiye. Mo si gba Jesu Kristi gbọ, Ọmọ rẹ kanṣoṣo, Oluwa wa; ẹniti a loyun rẹ nipa Ẹmi Mimọ, ti a bi ninu Maria Wundia; o jiya labẹ Pọntiu Pilatu, a kan a mọ agbelebu, o ku, a si sin i; o sọkalẹ lọ si ipo-oku; ni ijọ kẹta o jinde kuro ninu oku; o goke re ọrun, o si joko li ọwọ ọtun Ọlọrun Baba Olodumare; lati ibẹ ni yio ti wa ṣe idajọ alaye ati oku. Mo gba Ẹmi Mimọ gbọ; Ijọ Katoliki Mimọ; ìrẹpọ awọn eniyan mimọ; idariji ẹṣẹ; ajinde ara; ati iye ainipẹkun. Amin.
prayers.ourFather: Baba wa ti mbẹ li ọrun, ọwọ ni fun orukọ rẹ; ijọba rẹ de; ifẹ tirẹ ni ki a ṣe li aiye bi ti ọrun. Fun wa li onjẹ oni wa loni; dari ẹṣẹ wa ji wa, bi awa ti ndariji awọn ti o ṣẹ wa. Ma fa wa sinu idẹwo, ṣugbọn gba wa lọwọ buburu. Amin.
prayers.hailMary: Yinyin Maria, o kun fun ore-ọfẹ, Oluwa mbẹ pẹlu rẹ. Alabukun-fun ni iwọ ninu awọn obinrin, alabukun-fun si ni ọmọ inu rẹ, Jesu. Maria Mimọ, Iya Ọlọrun, gbadura fun awa ẹlẹṣẹ, nisisiyi ati li akoko iku wa. Amin.
prayers.gloryBe: Ogo ni fun Baba, ati fun Ọmọ, ati fun Ẹmi Mimọ. Bi o ti wa li atetekọṣe, bẹni o si wa nisisiyi, bẹni yio si wa titi aiye ainipẹkun. Amin.
prayers.fatimaPrayer: Jesu mi, dari ẹṣẹ wa ji wa, gba wa lọwọ ina ọrun apadi, mu gbogbo ọkàn lọ si ọrun, paapaa awọn ti o ṣe alaini aanu rẹ julọ.

luminous: Jesu fi ara rẹ han ni ibi igbeyawo ni Kana
Jesu kede Ijọba Ọlọrun o si pe ni si ironupiwada

name: Chinese (Simplified)
source: Chinese Catholic prayers (圣号经, 宗徒信经, 天主经, 圣母经, 圣三光荣经, 又圣母经) as used by Catholics in mainland China, simplified characters; closing prayer rendered by Claude

prayers.signOfCross: 因父及子及圣神之名。阿们。
prayers.apostlesCreed: 我信全能者天主父，化成天地。我信其唯一子，我等主耶稣基利斯督。我信其因圣神降孕，生于玛利亚之童身。我信其受难于般雀比辣多居官时，被钉于十字架，死而乃瘗。我信其降地狱，第三日自死者中复活。我信其升天，坐于全能者天主父之右。我信其日后从彼而来，审判生死者。我信圣神。我信有圣而公教会，诸圣相通功。我信罪之赦。我信肉身之复活。我信常生。阿们。
prayers.ourFather: 我们的天父，愿你的名受显扬；愿你的国来临；愿你的旨意奉行在人间，如同在天上。求你今天赏给我们日用的食粮；求你宽恕我们的罪过，如同我们宽恕别人一样；不要让我们陷于诱惑；但救我们免于凶恶。阿们。
prayers.hailMary: 万福玛利亚，你充满圣宠，主与你同在，你在妇女中受赞美，你的亲子耶稣同受赞美。天主圣母玛利亚，求你现在和我们临终时，为我们罪人祈求天主。阿们。
prayers.gloryBe: 愿光荣归于父，及子，及圣神。起初如何，今日亦然，直到永远。阿们。
prayers.fatimaPrayer: 我的耶稣，求你宽恕我们的罪过，救我们免于地狱的火焰，引领所有的灵魂进入天堂，特别是那些最需要你慈悲的灵魂。
prayers.hailHolyQueen:
万福母后，仁慈的母亲，我们的生命，我们的甘饴，我们的希望，万福！我们厄娃子孙，在此尘世，向你哀呼；我们在这涕泣之谷，向你叹息哭求。我们的主保，求你回顾，怜视我们。一旦流亡期满，使我们得见你的圣子、万民称颂的耶稣。宽仁的、慈悲的、甘饴的童贞玛利亚！
V. 天主圣母，请为我们祈求。
R. 使我们堪受基督的恩许。
prayers.closingPrayer: 我们祈祷吧。天主，你的唯一圣子以他的生活、死亡和复活，为我们赢得了永生的赏报；求你使我们默想荣福童贞玛利亚至圣玫瑰经的这些奥迹，效法其中所含的，获得其中所许的。因我们的主基督。阿们。

name: Zulu
source: Our Father and Hail Mary follow the Catholic isiZulu texts used in South Africa; Creed, Glory Be, Fatima prayer and mystery titles rendered by Claude — needs checking by a native Catholic speaker (SACBC prayer book). Hail Holy Queen and closing prayer left null (fall back to English/Latin).

prayers.signOfCross: Egameni likaYise, neleNdodana, nelikaMoya oNgcwele. Amen.
prayers.apostlesCreed: Ngikholwa nguNkulunkulu uYise onamandla onke, uMdali wezulu nomhlaba. NangoJesu Kristu, iNdodana yakhe eyodwa, iNkosi yethu; owakhulelwa ngoMoya oNgcwele, wazalwa nguMaria iNtombi; wahlupheka ngesikhathi sikaPontiyu Pilatu, wabethelwa esiphambanweni, wafa, wangcwatshwa; wehlela kwabafileyo; ngosuku lwesithathu wavuka kwabafileyo; wenyukela ezulwini, uhlezi ngakwesokunene sikaNkulunkulu uYise onamandla onke; uyakuvela khona ezokwahlulela abaphilayo nabafileyo. Ngikholwa nguMoya oNgcwele; iBandla elingcwele lamaKatolika; ubudlelwane babangcwele; ukuthethelelwa kwezono; ukuvuka komzimba; nokuphila okuphakade. Amen.
prayers.ourFather: Baba wethu osezulwini, maliphathwe ngobungcwele igama lakho. Umbuso wakho mawufike. Intando yakho mayenziwe emhlabeni njengasezulwini. Awusiphe namhla isinkwa sethu semihla ngemihla. Usithethelele izono zethu, njengoba nathi sibathethelela abasonayo. Ungasingenisi ekulingweni, kodwa usisindise kokubi. Amen.
prayers.hailMary: Sikhuleka kuwe Maria, ugcwele umusa, iNkosi inawe. Ubusisiwe wena kwabesifazane, ubusisiwe nesithelo sesisu sakho, uJesu. Maria Ongcwele, Nina kaNkulunkulu, sikhulekele thina zoni, manje nangesikhathi sokufa kwethu. Amen.
prayers.gloryBe: Udumo malube kuYise, nakuNdodana, nakuMoya oNgcwele. Njengoba kwakunjalo ekuqaleni, kunjalo manje, kuyakuba njalo kuze kube phakade naphakade. Amen.
prayers.fatimaPrayer: O Jesu wami, sithethelele izono zethu, usisindise emlilweni wesihogo, uyise yonke imiphefumulo ezulwini, ikakhulu leyo edinga kakhulu isihawu sakho.

luminous: UJesu umemezela uMbuso kaNkulunkulu futhi ubizela ekuphendukeni
glorious: Ukuthweswa kukaMaria umqhele njengeNdlovukazi yezulu nomhlaba
